capabilities.name: Run an AI agent in chat for your business
capabilities.question: Can a business run an AI agent that sells and supports customers in a chat app?

US.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses of all sizes globally on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in June 2026, and Google's Business Agent chat in Search is live for US retailers.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
New tech and tools for retailers to succeed in an agentic shopping era

GB.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses globally in June 2026, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog deploys it and says the regional limits now appear lifted. Meta's developer docs say a business must be based in "a country authorized for Meta Business Agent" but do not publish that list, and we found no UK-specific page, so the flag stays.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent

DE.note: Meta Business Agent reached the EU in mid-July 2026, after Brazil, according to Berlin-based WhatsApp partner 360dialog, which offers it on the WhatsApp Business Platform. Some business types (finance, health, alcohol and others) are excluded.

BR.note: Brazil was the first region where Meta Business Agent opened (per 360dialog), it is billed in BRL, and local platforms Blip, Zenvia and Yalo run AI sales and support agents on WhatsApp.

evidence.title: Upcoming pricing updates for Meta Business Agent, service and utility messages
Blip: Inteligência Conversacional para resultado de negócio
Yalo: Plataforma de ventas inteligente con agentes

MX.note: Meta Business Agent is open to businesses globally on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, and Mexico's Yalo sells AI sales agents on WhatsApp.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
Yalo: Plataforma de ventas inteligente con agentes

CL.note: Cliengo sells an AI agent on the WhatsApp Business API to companies in Chile. Meta Business Agent is also open to businesses globally, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog says its regional limits now appear lifted, though Meta does not publish its country list.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
¿Qué es un Agente IA de WhatsApp? Guía 2026 — Cliengo

CO.note: Colombia's Treble and Cliengo sell AI agents for WhatsApp sales and support. Meta Business Agent is also open to businesses globally, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog says its regional limits now appear lifted, though Meta does not publish its country list.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
La mejor plataforma de IA para WhatsApp
¿Qué es un Agente IA de WhatsApp? Guía 2026 — Cliengo

IN.note: Meta Business Agent is billed in INR, and Gupshup runs AI agents on WhatsApp for Indian enterprises.

evidence.title: Upcoming pricing updates for Meta Business Agent, service and utility messages

ES.note: Meta Business Agent reached the EU in mid-July 2026, after Brazil, according to WhatsApp partner 360dialog, which offers it on the WhatsApp Business Platform. Meta does not publish its country list, and some business types (finance, health, alcohol and others) are excluded.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent

FR.note: Meta Business Agent reached the EU in mid-July 2026, after Brazil, according to WhatsApp partner 360dialog, which offers it on the WhatsApp Business Platform; Meta began opening it to businesses globally in June 2026. Some business types (finance, health, alcohol and others) are excluded.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent

CA.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses globally on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in June 2026, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog says the regional limits appear lifted. Meta does not publish its country list, and we found no Canada-specific page.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent

JP.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses of all sizes globally in June 2026, on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog says the regional limits appear lifted; no Meta page names Japan. On LINE, the chat app most people in Japan use, LINE Yahoo's own AI mode for Official Accounts has no release date, and only its Agent i Biz web app launched, in limited form, in late October 2026.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
Agent i for Business (LINE公式アカウント AIモード: release undecided)

AU.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses globally on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram in June 2026, and WhatsApp partner 360dialog says the regional limits now appear lifted. We found no Australia-specific page, and finance, health and some other business types are excluded.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent

NG.note: Meta began opening Meta Business Agent to businesses of all sizes globally in June 2026, and Meta's Sub-Saharan Africa team is promoting it to Nigerian small businesses in the WhatsApp Business app, with an Ibadan spice seller quoted using it to answer customers and recommend products. Meta does not publish a country list.

evidence.title: Be There for Every Customer With Meta Business Agent
WhatsApp Spotlights Nigerian SMEs in New Campaign

KR.note: Kakao launched Kanana Customer Manager for KakaoTalk Channels in September 2025, so a business can have an AI agent answer customers in chat. It answers from the business's own posts, menus and store details, and no sign that it takes orders or payments was found. Meta Business Agent on WhatsApp is not confirmed for Korea.

evidence.title: 카카오 고객 응대용 AI 채팅 서비스 '카나나 상담매니저'

SG.note: Meta made Meta Business Agent available worldwide inside WhatsApp in June 2026, so businesses in Singapore can use it. Meta has not published a country list, and one vendor blog says finance and health businesses are excluded, which we could not confirm.

evidence.title: Meta's AI agent for WhatsApp Business is now available globally

ID.note: Meta Business Agent launched in Indonesia on 11 August 2026 at WhatsApp Business Summit Indonesia. Small businesses get it inside the WhatsApp Business app to answer customers and recommend products, and larger companies can build their own agents on Meta's Business Agent Platform, which can connect to Shopify, Zendesk and Shopee.

evidence.title: Meta Business Agent diklaim bisa bantu selesaikan penjualan (Meta Business Agent launch in Indonesia, in Indonesian)

IT.note: Meta opened Business Agent for WhatsApp and Messenger to businesses worldwide in June 2026, and the WhatsApp partner 360dialog says it reached the EU in mid-July 2026. We found no Italy-specific launch page from Meta, so this is low confidence. Some business types, such as finance, health and alcohol, are excluded.

evidence.title: Meta entra nella corsa dell'AI per le imprese, lancia il nuovo Business Agent

NL.note: Meta Business Agent, which Meta opened to businesses of all sizes worldwide in June 2026, has reached the EU since mid-July 2026, according to the WhatsApp partner 360dialog. Dutch businesses on the WhatsApp Business Platform can use it, with some business types excluded, such as finance, health, government, alcohol and gambling. Neither Meta nor 360dialog names the Netherlands.

capabilities.name: Pay a business without leaving the chat
capabilities.question: Can a customer pay an agent or business without leaving the chat?

US.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in the US.

GB.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in the UK.

DE.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats (in Germany since 2018), which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not offered in Germany.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands

BR.note: The WhatsApp Payments API for Brazil lets businesses send an order in chat that the customer pays by Pix code, card, boleto or payment link, although the Pix flow still hands off to the bank app and only works with Brazilian numbers. Telegram bot payments through Stripe also work.

MX.note: Only a niche channel: Telegram bot payments through Stripe work for Mexican businesses. WhatsApp payments are not launched in Mexico.

CL.note: No mainstream way to pay inside a chat was found: WhatsApp payments are not offered in Chile, and Stripe, the main Telegram payment provider, does not sign up businesses there.

CO.note: No mainstream way to pay inside a chat was found: WhatsApp payments are not offered in Colombia, and Stripe, the main Telegram payment provider, does not sign up businesses there.

IN.note: WhatsApp Pay runs on UPI, and the WhatsApp Payments API lets businesses take UPI, card and netbanking payments in chat through BillDesk, Razorpay, PayU or Zaakpay.

evidence.title: Receive payments via payment gateways on WhatsApp

ES.note: Only Telegram bot payments through Stripe, a niche channel. Apple Messages for Business was not listed for Spain, and WhatsApp payments are not offered in Spain.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands (Spain not listed)

FR.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats (in France since 2018), which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not offered in France.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands (France included)

CA.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which serves Canadian businesses, and Apple Messages for Business, which reached Canada in 2018 but which few brands offer. WhatsApp payments are not offered in Canada.

evidence.title: Apple Business Chat Expands Beyond United States to 10 Countries and 30 More Brands

JP.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which serves Japan. LINE Pay closed in Japan in April 2025, which also ended LINE Official Account payments, and PayPay inside LINE only sends money between people, not to businesses.

evidence.title: LINE公式アカウントのLINE Pay決済機能が終了！対処法は？
LINEでPayPayが使える (送金・割り勘)

AU.note: Only niche channels: Telegram bot payments through a payment provider, and Apple Pay inside Apple Messages for Business chats, which few businesses offer. WhatsApp payments are not launched in Australia.

NG.note: Paystack Index (early-access beta, June 2026) lets ChatGPT or Claude set up payments to merchants such as Chowdeck, but you approve each payment in a WhatsApp message, outside the AI chat. Payaza's Chat & Pay (April 2026) runs an automated checkout on a WhatsApp number, though it is not clear the payment stays in the chat. WhatsApp's own payments are not offered in Nigeria.

evidence.title: Payaza Launches 'Chat & Pay' Feature for instant WhatsApp payments

KR.note: No way for a Korean customer to pay a business inside KakaoTalk or Naver TalkTalk was found.

SG.note: Only niche options exist. Telegram bots can take card payments through providers such as Stripe, and Telegram says payments are accepted from over 200 countries through more than 20 providers. We found no WhatsApp payments service open to Singapore businesses.

ID.note: We found no way to pay a business inside a chat app in Indonesia. WhatsApp's payment API is listed for India only.

IT.note: We could not confirm any way for an Italian customer to pay a business inside a chat app. Telegram's bot payments page names no countries, so Italy is unconfirmed, and we did not check WhatsApp Pay or Apple Messages for Italy.

NL.note: The only route I could confirm is Telegram bot payments through Stripe, which Stripe supports for Dutch accounts. Telegram's bot payment rules name no country limits. I found no WhatsApp payment feature for Dutch businesses, and no sign that many Dutch businesses take payments in chat.
